name: Reginald Logan
notes: Quakertown descendant interviewed for the UNT Quakertown Oral History Project. His interview discusses his father John Logan, other relatives, forced relocation, segregated schooling, and Quakertown in family memory.

name: John Logan
notes: Father of Reginald Logan and identified in the oral history as a family member affected by forced removal from Quakertown.

name: Frederick Douglass Moore
notes: Prominent Denton educator discussed extensively in the Moore family oral history. Appointed principal of Frederick Douglass Colored School in 1915.

name: William Evelyn Woods
notes: Owner of the Woods House. Denton County records state that he purchased the house for $600 and later relocated with his wife Alberta from Quakertown to Solomon Hill.

name: Alberta Woods
notes: Wife of William Evelyn Woods. Denton County records describe the couple relocating from Quakertown to Solomon Hill in 1921.
